wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 09-009 pins the vanilla cheat-flag surface (the only three flags doomdef.h cheat_t carries: CF_NOCLIP=1, CF_GODMODE=2, CF_NOMOMENTUM=4) plus the isGodMode/isNoclip/isNoMomentum predicates via a src/vanilla re-export facade, and pins VANILLA_CHEATS_AFFECT_DEMO_PARITY=false. The read-only src/player/implement-god-mode-and-powerup-flags.ts already implements the flag semantics; cheat-code keystroke recognition is ST_Responder (live keyboard only) so a demo, carrying ticcmds not keystrokes, can never set a cheat flag — that is the parity invariant. Pure barrel + frozen manifest, no source modification.
